text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho concludes!!
Crossing the line in first place is—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hold on, hold on, hold on, sirrr!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me.
May I have your name?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Is that right?
Then, the winner of the Satsuki Sho was—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Heeey!!
The crowd is totally bewildered, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Don't you "Aww" me!!
Golshi-san, please promptly exit
the winner's circle—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My bad, Mame-chin.
That's just the leftover residue from warping.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, nice to meet ya, everyone~!
Gold Ship, a.k.a.—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, you thought it was Fenomeno~!
Nope, that's Golshi for sure!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Before the race! During the race!
Trampling over all theories and textbook examples!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Every single thing! Absolutely everything—!
—...damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: You must not use a false name!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Do you know what will happen to the future if such imitations run rampant?! Yes—

text_block_list.name: Kid Who Admires Golshi
text_block_list.text:
It's me, Fenomeno!
Make sure you leave the bell peppers out of dinner...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Lies running rampant! Utter confusion all around!
Th-this is un-ac-cep-ta-bleeee!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The threat Golshi-san poses cannot be overlooked!
I have no time to sit around moping!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I won't let children be led down the path of villainy!
I refuse to let an outlaw like that
become an idol for children!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I won't let you become the sole, uncontested favorite Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely not going to let you be the only one everyone looks up to!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even if my running lacks flash, even if I'm not popular!
—At the very least, I'll climb to the very top in standing!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: The one who will become the Derby Umamusume—is this officer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno points her finger and makes her declaration.
Her expression was brimming with determination.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, alriiiight!
Next up is the Derby~!
